leads.title: Gender Equality Act 2019
leads.documents: Prohibits direct/indirect discrimination in all areas including on sexual orientation or gender identity; requires government measures to eliminate stereotypes/prejudice and sensitize judicial/law enforcement officials
leads.detail: Cited in article as 'Gender Equality Act 2019'; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Births, Deaths and Marriages Registration Act 1988
leads.documents: Marriage recognition law; section 428(1) assumes opposite-sex parties (male 18+, female 16+) and is basis for lack of same-sex marriage/civil union recognition
leads.detail: Cited as 'Births, Deaths and Marriages Registration Act 1988, section 428(1)'; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Code of Judicial Conduct 2008
leads.documents: Prohibits judges and court staff/lawyers from manifesting bias/prejudice/harassment based on sexual orientation, gender and other grounds in judicial duties
leads.detail: Cited as 'Code of Judicial Conduct 2008' with quoted bias/harassment provisions; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Constitution of the Marshall Islands / statutory non-discrimination provision
leads.documents: Constitutional/statutory prohibition of discrimination including sexual orientation (Marshallese quoted), marital status and family status; article notes unknown if guarantees same-sex marriage right, Supreme Court yet to rule
leads.detail: Cited in article with Marshallese phrases 'rō rej kalok an itok limoier kōn kōra ak emmaan', 'rimare ke jaab', 'ej baamle ke jaab'; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: United Nations joint statement on ending acts of violence and related human rights violations based on sexual orientation and gender identity - 2011
leads.documents: UN statement condemning violence/discrimination against LGBTQ people; documents Marshall Islands signed in 2011
leads.detail: Cited as 2011 UN joint statement signing; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: 2016 Universal Periodic Review recommendations by Germany and Israel
leads.documents: Recommendations to Marshall Islands to prohibit discrimination on basis of sexual orientation and gender identity
leads.detail: Cited as 'In 2016, the Marshall Islands received recommendations from Germany and Israel'; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Human Truth Foundation LGBTQ rights ranking
leads.documents: Ranks Marshall Islands at 88 for LGBTQ rights, compared to Palau (86), Nauru (87) and Micronesia (90)
leads.detail: Cited as 'Human Truth Foundation has listed the Marshall Islands at rank 88'; no URL visible in provided text
